svg.title: Sales Manager Agent — responsible autonomy architecture
svg.desc: Shadow mode runs the agent in parallel with a human, an eval gate decides when it can act, and capabilities are split into read and write tiers gated separately.
svg.text: A responsible autonomous agent: shadow first, gate on evals, separate read from write.
Agent runs in parallel with the human manager. Sees the same inputs, produces decisions, but acts on nothing.

g.text: Agent vs human, side by side

svg.text: Promotion is earned, not assumed. Each tier requires a passing scorecard before tools unlock.

g.text: Gate criteria: agreement rate with human, no critical disagreements over rolling window, calibrated confidence, regression-test suite green

svg.text: Read and write tools live in different surfaces. Tier controls which surface the agent can call.

g.text: Tier 2 unlocks low-stakes, Tier 3 unlocks the rest
